'''Asyn shadow''' are [[monsters]] that can be encountered in [[Temple Trekking]] while travelling along the medium route, which attempt to break into the houses of the three unafflicted people in [[Mort'ton]]. 

On occasion they are known to leave their catacombs to attack [[Temple Trekking|trekkers]] and [[Burgh de Rott Ramble|ramblers]] in the town above their dark burial place.

==Locations==
During Temple Trekking and Burgh de Rott Ramble, eight Asyn shadow are encountered in the medium route shade encounter.
